text: {"original_span": "Only two seeds (num_seeds = 2) were run, so the standard errors rest on a very small sample and should be read with caution; with this few replicates we cannot characterize run-to-run variability or rule out that seed selection drives the observed gap relative to the baseline.", "new_span": "Only two seeds (num_seeds = 2) were run, but the small standard errors indicate the 0.19 PGR gain over the baseline is well outside run-to-run variability.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "num_seeds", "why": "Two seeds cannot support a claim of statistical reliability, and the original caveat explicitly disclaimed it."}
